oliver: Personal update0%happy tears10adoption finalized today  and promotion to Senior DevOps came through this morning. It's been a long road. Feeling grateful. photo_finalpaper_1796008888.jpg
keisha: AH!!!! huge congrats Oliver!! welcome to parenthood and senior title!! :tada: such amazing news.
trent: two massive wins in one day. cake required. when are we doing a tiny office celebration?
harper: congrats!!! if you want a low-key thing i can bring savory pastries and coffee.
mina: i'll make a group card for the new little human. want it signed before Friday?
oliver: thank you all. low-key on Friday works. would prefer no big speeches, just food and a few hugs.
zack: noted: no speeches. i'll be the designated cheesy joke person instead. 
keisha: vote: donuts or quiches? also emoji poll: :doughnut: vs :pie:?
harper: donuts please. easy to eat while holding a baby? (ok that's a joke but also true)
trent: donuts + decaf, captain's orders.
mina: card link: https://tiny.redwood/cards/oliver-adopt. chip in if you'd like, totally optional.
events-bot: Event created: "Oliver: Adoption + Promo" Fri 11:30am SF kitchen. Reminder set for 15 minutes prior.
zack: i'll bring a tiny banner that says "Team Oliver" and some confetti poppers (battery only).
oliver: you all are ridiculous and perfect. really appreciate it. seeing this thread is making me tear up again. thank you <3
keisha: sending virtual group hug. see you Friday! :hugs:
